name: Respect The Wife
overview: Scripture teaches that a godly marriage is founded on the covenant relationship between husband and wife, who are united as one flesh (Genesis 2:24). The husband is called to love his wife sacrificially, as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:25), while the wife is instructed to respect her husband (Ephesians 5:33). A wife is described as a precious and virtuous gift from the Lord, whose value is above rubies (Proverbs 31:10; Proverbs 18:22), and faithfulness within this covenant is essential, as God Himself is witness to the marriage bond (Malachi 2:14).
